items.title: Rockwell and Zebra Earnings Are Both Strong—but Only One Automation Stock Is Up
items.summary: Shares of one automation technology provider slipped after earnings, while another jumped.  Wall Street was looking for EPS of $3.38 from sales of $2.2 billion, according to FactSet.  Full-year guidance was raised to a range of $13 to $13.30, up from a prior range of $12.50 to $13.10.
